bio: The ancient Greek poet to whom the Iliad and the Odyssey are attributed. Nothing certain is known about his life: ancient writers disagreed about when and where he lived, and modern scholars debate whether one poet composed both epics, or whether ‘Homer’ stands for a tradition of oral poets (the ‘Homeric Question’).

works.attribution: Attributed to Homer in antiquity; now regarded as the work of later poets.
